content: गारुड {%a.%} (-डी|{%f.%}) [गरुडस्येदम् अण्] .²1 Shaped like Garuḍa. .²2 Coming from or relating to Garuḍa. .{@-डः, -डम्@} .²1 An emerald; राशिर्मणीनामिव गारुडानां सपद्मरागः फलितो विभाति <ls>R. 13. 53</ls>. .²2 A charm against (snake) poison; संगृहीतगारुडेन <ls>K. 51</ls> (where it has sense 1 also). .²3 A missile presided over by Garuḍa. .²4 A military array (व्यूह) of the shape of Garuḍa. .²5 Gold.
